title: IGCAR Trade Apprentice Online Form 2026
organization: Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research
qualification: ITI in relevant trade as per Apprentices Act / IGCAR notice
ageLimit: As published in the official notification
applicationFee: As published in the official notification
selectionProcess: Online application → Written exam / CBT / PET as notified → Document verification → Final merit
documentsRequired: Photo, signature, educational certificates, category certificate (if any) and valid photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://www.igcar.gov.in
2. Open the latest advertisement for IGCAR Trade Apprentice Online Form 2026
3. Register or log in and fill the application
4. Upload photo, signature and required documents, then pay the fee if applicable
5. Submit and print the confirmation page
shortDescription: IGCAR Trade Apprentice Online Form 2026. See the official notice at www.igcar.gov.in.
content:
Indira Gandhi Centre for Atomic Research is accepting (or has reopened) online applications for Trade Apprentice.

Read the detailed advertisement for eligibility, fee, dates and district/post-wise vacancies before you submit the form.

How to apply

  1. Open www.igcar.gov.in
  2. Complete registration / OTR if required
  3. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee
  4. Print the confirmation page
